claim: The bundled theme asset is committed as an unexpanded Git LFS pointer (*.fsbt is tracked by LFS), so the app bundles the pointer text instead of the theme package and seeding it fails.
seedBundled is called unawaited from main.dart, but seeded.fetch(), AssetManifest.loadFromAssetBundle and seeded.put run outside the per-asset try, so a failure escapes as an unhandled async error.
When an update replaces the currently selected installation, _replaceOlder calls select(next, ...), which rewrites themeMode from the package default and discards the user's chosen light/dark mode.
allTexts returns every value of a description table, including non-strings such as numbers; the search filter then calls toLowerCase on them and throws, breaking the store page.
